introduction: New Mexico LIHEAP helps eligible households with home-energy costs. Begin through YesNM or call the state public-inquiry line to discuss intake and an urgent utility problem.
description: New Mexico LIHEAP helps eligible households with home-energy costs. Begin through YesNM or call the state public-inquiry line to discuss intake and an urgent utility problem.

sections.who: The administering agency assesses household finances, residence and energy circumstances. Ask for current program-year limits rather than using an older benefit or income table.
sections.get: Assistance can address qualifying heating, cooling or crisis needs. Ask which component fits and how an approved payment reaches the energy provider.
sections.docs:
• Household income information.
  • Current energy bill and account details.
  • Identity and residence evidence requested by ISD.
  • A shutoff or fuel-delivery notice if relevant.
sections.apply:
1. Start intake

    The federal LIHEAP directory links YesNM for New Mexico applications.

  2. Explain the energy need

    Call 800-283-4465 about application help, available components and urgent account circumstances.

  3. Complete verification

    Ask for the agency’s checklist and retain the submission confirmation and decision.
sections.after: The federal directory lists year-round operation, but availability and awards depend on the agency’s current review. Discuss any remaining balance or pending shutoff with the utility.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Federal New Mexico LIHEAP contacts and intake, updated August 2026. USA Assistance background guide. The linked provider must confirm current eligibility and intake arrangements.

faqs: Is there a winter-only application window?
The current federal New Mexico directory lists year-round program dates.
Does a prior-year award guarantee the same amount?
No. Ask the agency about the current program year and household assessment.
Where can I ask about the application?
The federal directory lists 800-283-4465 for public inquiries.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
blockers: Federal directory verifies contacts, pathway and year-round dates; current state LIHEAP eligibility and crisis page inaccessible, so current detailed rules are not verified.
